messages:
sam_release: OK for RC 3.4.1 to be created and dark-launched in prod SLO window? I pushed candidate build and pinned container tag rc-3.4.1.
maria_eng: 👍 created tag and uploaded artifacts. CI passed, integration smoke green. I will run the KV warm job after promo if we go.
sam_release: thanks. plan: create RC, pin routing to rc variants 0% traffic (darklaunch), enable telemetry sampling at 1% for 20m, check model latency and error rates, then promote to 25% canary if clean. rollback plan: revert routing pin + kill canary deployment. no infra changes.
jonathan_sre: I can monitor. Will watch 1% telemetry and set alerts on error-rate > 0.5% or p50 latency regress > 150ms.
liz_prod: product sign-off pending small release notes blurb. TL;DR on user-visible: faster infer hotpath for short prompts, no API changes.
sam_release: deploy-bot, create rc object and darklaunch please
deploy-bot: 
```
create-rc --tag rc-3.4.1 --channels darklaunch,canary --owner @sam_release
Result: RC created: rc-3.4.1 (id: 0x9f4)
Scheduling darklaunch rollout: region=us-east-1, sample=1%, duration=20m
``` 
maria_eng: starting telemetry sanity checks now. running curl smoke against edge endpoint:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ${RC_TOKEN}" | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
maria_eng: smoke ok from 3 hosts, latency median ~72ms, tail spikes at 220ms on one host (investigating), no errors yet.
jonathan_sre: I see the same in traces. Host gpu-wer-07 had nv_peer reset at T-3m, dropping a few requests. I've flagged to infra team; not blocking promo if errors stay <= threshold.
sheriff_roam: I'll be on-call for the promo window. If we hit >0.5% errors or sustained p95 > 400ms, i'll trigger rollback. :rotating_light:
liz_prod: doc blurb ready, adding to release notes. small note: add a line about canary behavior for customers using dedicated pools.
sam_release: 14m into darklaunch, error-rate 0.06%, p50 steady, p95 improved. recommend promote to 5% canary in 10m. objections?
maria_eng: no objections. will run KV warm after 5% flip.
jonathan_sre: fine from SRE. pushing alert thresholds to stricter for canary: error > 0.3% or p95 > 300ms triggers rollback.
liz_prod: product + PM signoff :thumbsup:
sam_release: deploy-bot, promote rc-3.4.1 to canary 5% and pin routing for canary group
deploy-bot: 
```
promote-rc --id 0x9f4 --to canary --percent 5 --pin true
Result: Promotion scheduled. Canary rollout started at 2026-03-20T16:34:20Z. Ops channel: #eng-oncall
``` 
maria_eng: KV warm started against canary hosts, warming keys from traffic patterns.
jonathan_sre: saw transient p95 blip to 420ms at T+2m from canary - rolled back that batch automatically by autoscaler but overall error-rate still 0.12%. watching.
sam_release: note: if the p95 holds above 350ms after 5 minutes we abort to rollback. sheriff_roam, you got that rule?
sheriff_roam: got it. on standby. will call rollback after 5m sustained breach. ping me in #eng-oncall and i'll execute.
maria_eng: after 8m canary is healthy, p95 back to 190ms, no errors. telemetry looks good across embeddings and chat routes.
sam_release: good. schedule promo window to 25% in 30m, we'll run small user-facing smoke and then full promo in next maintenance slot if green.
liz_prod: tagging release notes, scheduling release announcement for next day. any changes to compliance flags?
jonathan_sre: no extra compliance items. KMS keys unchanged.
sam_release: final check: list of roll-forward owners and rollback steps in case: 
- owner: @sam_release (promo control)
- rollback operator: @sheriff_roam (revert routing + remove canary pods)
- infra contact: @jonathan_sre
- product: @liz_prod
maria_eng: logging this thread into release docket. I'll attach smoke logs after the window.
sam_release: everyone good? :thumbsup: If no objections i'll mark rc-3.4.1 as cleared for staged promotion.
liz_prod: cleared :white_check_mark:
jonathan_sre: cleared
sheriff_roam: cleared
maria_eng: cleared
sam_release: marking rc-3.4.1 cleared and closing darklaunch window. Will open another thread for full production promo.
deploy-bot: RC 0x9f4 (rc-3.4.1) status updated: darklaunch success -> canary 5% in-progress -> cleared for staged promotion (owner:@sam_release)
